name: io.github.shinpr/mcp-image
description: AI image generation and editing with prompt optimization and quality presets

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (default) for local MCP clients, or http for a stateless remote MCP endpoint

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address (defaults to 127.0.0.1; Docker uses 0.0.0.0)

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP listen port (defaults to 3000)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required in HTTP mode: cryptographically random private URL token of 32 to 128 URL-safe characters; the remote endpoint is /mcp/<token>

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Image provider to use: 'gemini' (default), 'openai', or 'seedream'

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key for image generation when IMAGE_PROVIDER=gemini (get from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for image generation when IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai. Requires OpenAI organization verification to access GPT Image 2.6 (https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/general)

environmentVariables.name: ARK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: BytePlus ModelArk AP region API key required when IMAGE_PROVIDER=seedream

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Custom Gemini API root for image generation and prompt enhancement; the Google SDK adds the API version and model path

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Custom OpenAI-compatible API base URL including its API prefix, for example https://provider.example/v1; used for images and prompt enhancement

environmentVariables.name: ARK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Custom ModelArk API base URL for images and prompt enhancement (defaults to https://ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com/api/v3)

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Gemini image model for all quality presets

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the OpenAI-compatible image model for all quality presets; use the exact model ID offered by your provider

environmentVariables.name: SEEDREAM_IMAGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Seedream image model or endpoint ID for all quality presets

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_TEXT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the model used for Gemini prompt enhancement

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the model used for OpenAI-compatible Responses API prompt enhancement; use SKIP_PROMPT_ENHANCEMENT=true for image-only providers

environmentVariables.name: SEEDREAM_TEXT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the model used for Seedream prompt enhancement

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative path where generated images will be saved (defaults to ./output)

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_QUALITY
environmentVariables.description: Default quality preset: 'fast' (default), 'balanced', or 'quality'

environmentVariables.name: SKIP_PROMPT_ENHANCEMENT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to disable automatic prompt optimization and use direct prompts
